title: The Extractor Fan — EN/KO/IT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Korean Italian language learning absurdist wordplay comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano bar, warm and unhurried]
My uncle loves tractors
He went to the Royal Show every year
Not for the animals or the show bags
He went for the tractors

[Verse 1 - English]
He stood in the pavilion for considerable time
Reading the specifications on the placards
And then one year something went wrong
A tractor moved in a direction that did not suit my uncle
He was in hospital
Everyone brought tractor-themed gifts
A cup, a picture, a poem about tractors
Six months later, first night out
A woman walked across the floor toward him, smiling
She said do you want to get out of here
He said no, I've got this
He breathed in slowly, he breathed out slowly
The room cleared
She said how did you do that

[Verse 2 - 한국어 Hangugeo]
그는 트랙터를 사랑합니다
(He loves tractors)
그는 왕립 쇼에 매년 갔습니다
(He went to the Royal Show every year)
트랙터 때문에 병원에 갔습니다
(He went to hospital because of a tractor)
모두가 트랙터 선물을 가져왔습니다
(Everyone brought tractor-themed gifts)
첫 번째 외출에서 여자가 다가왔습니다
(On his first night out a woman approached)
그는 천천히 숨을 들이쉬고 내쉬었습니다
(He breathed in slowly and breathed out slowly)
방이 비워졌습니다
(The room cleared)
그녀가 말했습니다 어떻게 하셨나요
(She said how did you do that)

[Chorus - Italiano]
Guardò verso di lei
(He looked at her)
Fece un altro respiro
(He breathed out once more)
Disse — sono un ex fan dei trattori
(He said — I am an ex-tractor fan)
Lei ci pensò per un po'
(She considered this for a reasonable time)
Disse — possiamo restare
(She said — we can stay)
Un fan degli ex-trattori
(An ex-tractor fan)
Ha liberato la stanza
(Cleared the room)

[Bridge - all three]
I am an ex-tractor fan — 저는 전 트랙터 팬입니다 — Sono un ex fan dei trattori
Ex-tractor — 환풍기 — Estrattore
Same breath — 같은 숨결 — Stesso respiro

[Outro]
He still goes to the Royal Show
그는 아직도 왕립 쇼에 갑니다
Va ancora al Royal Show
At a slightly greater distance from the tractors
트랙터에서 약간 더 멀리
A una distanza leggermente maggiore dai trattori
Still an ex-tractor fan — 여전히 전 트랙터 팬 — Ancora un ex fan dei trattori
